name: ExerciseFee
description: A class defining the fee payable on exercise of an option. This fee may be defined as an amount or a percentage of the notional exercised. As a difference with FpML, it extends the BuyerSeller class.

feeAmount.description: The amount of fee to be paid on exercise. The fee currency is that of the referenced notional.

feePaymentDate.description: The date on which exercise fee(s) will be paid. It is specified as a relative date.

feeRate.description: A fee represented as a percentage of some referenced notional. A percentage of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

notionalReference.description: A pointer style reference to the associated notional schedule defined elsewhere in the document.

payer.description: Specifies the counterparty responsible for making the payments defined by this structure.  The party is one of the two principal parties to the transaction.

receiver.description: Specifies the party that receives the payments corresponding to this structure.  The party is one of the two counterparties to the transaction.
